map.name: fortress-quad
map.description: Four identical corner fortresses, rotated 90 degrees: the map edges close two sides of each base; two owned, destructible wall lines close the others, each with one allied-only door. Each base has 1,200 capital inside and 2,800 at exposed flank expansions outside. Leave through either door; breach enemy walls or doors to enter. Shared deposits lie between corners and in the center.

order.code:
const e = self.nearestEnemy && self.nearbyEnemies().filter(x=>!x.ruin && !x.isBuilding).sort((a,b)=>self.distanceTo(a)-self.distanceTo(b))[0];
if (e && self.distanceTo(e) <= 7) self.flee(e); else self.hold();
